notes:
Config: /etc/bind/named.conf.local, named.conf.options, named.conf.log, db.<domain>, db.<reverse>
Ports: 53/udp (queries), 53/tcp (zone transfers/AXFR)
Dangerous directives: allow-query, allow-recursion, allow-transfer (any/wide -> AXFR to anyone), zone-statistics
